projects.name: Smart Cane
bullets: Created for visually impaired people to help with their everyday lives, built with a teammate for HackStorm.
Implemented computer vision using the llama-4-scout model via Groq API, text-to-speech using Microsoft Embedded TTS, and overall software structure.
Warns the user about elevator arrivals, steep edges/staircases, crowded places, and available seats relative to the user.

projects.name: Transfer Tracker
projects.meta: React, JavaScript, Supabase, Cloudflare Workers, AI | 2026
bullets: Built an AI-powered transfer planner combining Cal-GETC requirements, major preparation, and student-imported ASSIST agreements into editable term-by-term roadmaps.
Implemented agreement parsing that preserves AND/OR course logic and flags unarticulated requirements, plus AP credit rules for Cal-GETC, UC, and CSU unit caps and area assignments.
Added local autosave and Supabase account syncing with Google sign-in and revision conflict resolution; kept original PDFs out of storage and AI API credentials in a Cloudflare Worker.
